name: std-event-log
description: std-event-log — generic chronological event feed (Stripe activity log / GitHub PR timeline / Linear event feed style). Renders a vertical `timeline` with type-coded dots, a single horizontal chip-bar of kind filters (All + per-kind), reverse-chronological sort, and an inline form for logging events that weren't auto-captured. `config.kindOptions` maps each kind → status/icon/label so consuming molecules/organisms get type-coded visuals without re-implementing topology. Topology = loading / viewing / backfilling / error.

title.label: Section title
title.description: Heading shown above the activity timeline

displayPageSize.label: How many entries per page should a pager show?
displayPageSize.description: Page size a consumer-composed std-pagination control should use to compute total pages (e.g. from totalCount). This atom's own timeline pattern has no built-in pager UI, so this knob is informational for the composed control, not consumed by the timeline itself.
displayPageSize.synonyms: visible rows, items per page, display limit

filterBarLook.label: Filter bar look
filterBarLook.description: Visual treatment for the embedded filter bar, mirroring std-filter's own enum. Only applies when `filters` is non-empty.
filterBarLook.synonyms: filter bar style, facet style, chips, pills

kindOptions.label: Event kinds
kindOptions.description: Maps each event kind to its label, icon, and status color

timelineLook.label: Timeline look
timelineLook.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for the timeline.

bodySearch.label: Show the log's own search box?
bodySearch.description: Embeds a search box above the activity feed. Set true only when the page has no other search affordance (e.g. no page-level std-search), so the surface shows one search box instead of two. False is the default — no consumer of this atom has ever had a search box.
bodySearch.synonyms: inline search, log search, built-in search, show search

cardLook.label: Card look
cardLook.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for cards rendered by this atom.

filters.label: Which filters should appear above the feed?
filters.description: Dropdown filter facets by field, rendered as an embedded filter bar above the timeline; each selection fires REFETCH_FILTER on this trait, ANDed with the current kind tab. Empty (the default) = no filter bar — the right setting whenever the page already composes std-filter beside this atom and routes XFilter.FILTER -> REFETCH_FILTER, or relies solely on the built-in kind-filter chips (driven by kindOptions, which this knob does not duplicate or replace). Use this knob only for an extra facet beyond kind (e.g. actor, priority).
filters.synonyms: filter bar, faceted filters, field filters, dropdowns

formFields.label: Backfill fields
formFields.description: Inputs shown in the form for manually logging missed events

searchPlaceholder.label: Search box placeholder text
searchPlaceholder.description: Hint text inside the log's search box.
searchPlaceholder.synonyms: search hint, placeholder, search box text

pageSize.label: How many entries per page when paging?
pageSize.description: Records fetched from the server per REFETCH_PAGE request. The initial load and every search/kind/filter refetch stay unpaginated (load everything that matches) so the default unlimited activity feed is unchanged; only an explicit REFETCH_PAGE from a composed std-pagination control applies this limit.
pageSize.synonyms: fetch limit, records per page, page limit
